# Frontend Module

Frontend is a local single-page console for MTASA.

Main tasks:

1. Configure API and run settings.
2. Check API connectivity before run.
3. Select dataset path (scoring mode is fixed to official_like_latest).
4. Start/stop Fool loop.
5. Trigger Genius-only evaluation.
6. Display status, reports, logs, best solver path, AI endpoint, and last error.

Implementation uses Python standard library HTTP server and vanilla JS.
